# Kian's shared agent context

Small, cross-agent context store. It is not a general personal wiki.

## Active files

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): read and write boundaries
- [context.md](context.md): current cross-project context and durable preferences
- [notes.md](notes.md): preserved cross-project syntheses

All other Markdown files in this repository belong to the retired May 2026 entity-wiki experiment. Do not use them as current context.
